Long waiting time and bad attitude. Thời gian chờ thức ăn rất lâu, thái độ phục vụ quá tệ
Jan 2024 • Family
It is disappointing to encounter a super long waiting time for your food, especially when the excuse given is that it is made from scratch.
Additionally, the behavior of the Australian lady, whether she is the owner or manager, is unacceptable. Confronting a client who wrote a negative review and then cleaning the table while you were still eating is extremely rude and disrespectful. Customer service should always be a top priority, and such behavior reflects poorly on the establishment.

Furthermore, it is so gross to see that the Australian lady responds to negative reviews on Google by rudely bashing the reviewers and asking them not to return. This kind of response shows a lack of professionalism and an unwillingness to address and resolve customer concerns. It is important for businesses to take feedback seriously and strive to improve their services rather than dismissing or attacking their customers.

Based on your experience and the negative reviews, it seems that the restaurant may need to reconsider its approach to customer service. If you are looking for a place that offers both food and beer, I would recommend exploring other options in the city such as Uniquely, Tocepo, or Lê La. These establishments may provide a better dining experience and offer a variety of craft beers to enjoy.
